text:
renee: pulling together UX for automatic fallback. current console shows 'fallback:on' + sample %. operators want clearer minimap of why.
arjun: agreed. short pills with rule name + value, e.g. '5xx_rate 1.9% (10m)'. expand for details.
cole: can we add an 'escalate sampling' policy: baseline audit pct, escalate_after_s, escalate_to_pct? minimal fields in UI.
renee: sketch: inline text 'audit 0.5% -> escalates to 100% after 300s' with a small chevron to change.
arjun: API names: fallback.audit_pct, fallback.escalate_after_s, fallback.escalate_pct. please keep proto stable.
cole: add an 'ack' button that opens small modal requiring optional reason; if sticky_override set, require reason. badge shows 'acked by <user>'.
ops-bot: ALERT: rollout/edge-canary triggered fallback: p95_latency=812ms over 5m. audit_blob=ab_179654_01. sampling escalated to 100%.
renee: include audit_blob copy button in UI and a tiny 'jump to playback' link. blob should contain trace id + commit + cohort.
arjun: for noise control, only require ack for rollouts > 15% traffic. smaller canaries are readonly.
cole: task list: arjun update proto, renee mock panel, i'll wire buttons. check-in tomorrow.
renee: thanks. leaving note to add mobile-friendly modal and role gating.
